Report mandates (9 report mandates)

Statutory duties that require this agency to publish or file a report, with a City Record filing receipt when that report appears.

  • ◆Mandate · Publish a report containing data for the previous month, including the number of complaints of illegal parking of vehicles operated on behalf of the city in the specified types of locations.
    report · deadline 2020-02-15 · monthly · § 23-304(d)(2) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · The department shall submit to the council a report of the results of the assessment conducted pursuant to subdivision b of this section.
    report · deadline 2022-06-12 · one-time · Section 1(c) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Report to the mayor and the speaker of the council on updating complaint types on the 311 customer service center website and mobile device platforms, post the report on the department website and the 311 customer service center website, and include the specified data, local-law list, delay explanations, challenges, and remediation efforts.
    report · deadline 2023-04-28 · one-time · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Issue a report to the speaker of the council and the mayor including the results of each required survey, disaggregated by the language in which the survey was conducted.
    report · deadline: No later than July 1 of each year · annual · § 23-304(d) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit to the council and post on its website a report summarizing the causes of and remedies for calls that disconnect during language identification.
    report · deadline: By January 30 of each year · annual · § 23-308(c) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Publish on its website a report detailing progress in implementing the broadband internet access plan.
    report · deadline: No later than 1 year after the department publishes the first plan required by section 23-1302 · annual · Administrative Code § 23-1304 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council, and publish on the department’s website, an annual report on rooftop activity complaints submitted during the preceding year, containing the specified information.
    report · deadline: No later than March 31 of each year · annual · § 23-308(c) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Issue a report to the speaker of the council and the mayor summarizing the aggregate results of the required surveys, disaggregated by the language in which each survey was conducted, and including the most recent agency report cards.
    report · deadline: No later than July 1 of each year · annual · § 23-306(e) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report to the speaker of the council containing the results and specified analyses of the cloud-first policy assessment.
    report · deadline: No later than one year after the effective date of this local law · one-time · § 1(c) · Source law↗
